# Dracula

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-dracula)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-dracula)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-dracula)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-dracula)

Dracula is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. Added in 6.31.0.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-dracula codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `dracula` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { dracula } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-dracula';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, dracula],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `dracula` | `Extension` |
| `draculaMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#282a36` |
| Active line | `#2c2e3b` |
| Selection | `#373a4a` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.53:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#ff79c6` | - | 5.97:1 | 5.64:1 | 4.72:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#ff79c6` | - | 5.97:1 | 5.64:1 | 4.72:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#ff79c6` | - | 5.97:1 | 5.64:1 | 4.72:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#f8f8f2` | - | 13.36:1 | 12.62:1 | 10.55:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#f8f8f2` | - | 13.36:1 | 12.62:1 | 10.55:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#f8f8f2` | - | 13.36:1 | 12.62:1 | 10.55:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#50fa7b` | - | 10.38:1 | 9.80:1 | 8.20:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#f8f8f2` | - | 13.36:1 | 12.62:1 | 10.55:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#8be9fd` | italic | 10.29:1 | 9.72:1 | 8.13:1 |

| Namespace | `namespace` | `#8be9fd` | - | 10.29:1 | 9.72:1 | 8.13:1 |
| String | `string` | `#f1fa8c` | - | 12.74:1 | 12.04:1 | 10.07:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#f8f8f2` | background, active line, selection | 10.55:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#7f90c4` | gutter | 4.54:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#f8f8f2` | background, active line | 12.62:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#bd93f9` | background | 5.90:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #50fa7b` | background, active line | 9.80:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#ffb86c, 1px solid #ffb86c` | background (fill or outline) | 8.36:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#44475a8c` | active line | 1.20:1 | Pass |
